title: Ohana Spirit | KEY.co
description_expanded: This beautifully appointed four-bedroom retreat in the heart of the Mauna Lani Resort is thoughtfully designed for gatherings of up to ten guests. Featuring two private primary suites with king beds and ensuites, a guest room with two queen beds, and a flexible Twin XL room that converts to a king, the layout offers both comfort and versatility for families and friends. The airy open-concept design connects the kitchen, dining area, and great room to a spacious lanai with a full outdoor kitchen, creating seamless indoor–outdoor living framed by stunning sunset views. High-end mattresses, luxurious linens, a fully equipped chef’s kitchen, oversized seating for relaxing evenings, and fast WiFi ensure an effortless and elevated stay. This home includes FREE Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort passes in 2026. The Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort was voted #1 resort in Hawaii by USA Today. Normally resort passes cost $100/adult and $60/child but when staying at this home, use for up to 10 people is complimentary with no additional cost each and every day of your stay. This includes use of resort pools, the river pool, waterslides, hot tub, saltwater lagoon for snorkeling, lounge chairs, towels and parking validation for one vehicle. It also includes a 10% discount on Spa Treatments, 10% discount on Lagoon toys and Cabana rentals. Guests love this resort pass which gives them the best of both worlds with hotel privileges and a comfortable well-equipped vacation home.
